How it works

Capture first. Organize later.

Save in place

Highlight a phrase and use a shortcut, the popup, or Chrome's context menu.

Keep the source

Phraselet stores the nearby context, page title, and URL with every phrase.

Build your library

Search, add notes and tags, archive phrases, and organize your collection in bulk.

Local by design

Your library stays on your device.

Phraselet's public version doesn't require an account or use analytics, advertising, or a developer-operated backend. Your library stays in Chrome's local extension storage, with restorable JSON backups plus portable Markdown, CSV, and selected-phrase copy whenever you want to take it elsewhere.
